about.description: Root Cabs provides local, airport and outstation taxi services with verified drivers, transparent fares and 24/7 online booking across Tamil Nadu.

mainEntity.name: How Can I Book My Ride With Root Cabs?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can book your ride online through the Root Cabs app by selecting your pickup location, destination and preferred vehicle. Review the fare details and confirm your booking.

mainEntity.name: Can I Book A Ride For Later With Root Cabs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Root Cabs allows you to schedule your trip in advance by selecting your preferred pickup date and time during the online ride booking process.

mainEntity.name: What Ride Options Are Available With Root Cabs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Root Cabs offers Auto, Cab and Bike Taxi services for city travel. You can also book local taxis, one-way drop taxis, round trips, hourly rentals and parcel delivery.

mainEntity.name: Can I Book A Transfer From The Airport Through Root Cabs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can book a transfer from the airport or arrange an airport drop through the Root Cabs app. Add the correct terminal, pickup details and travel time while confirming your ride.

mainEntity.name: Will The Driver Ask For An Amount Above The App Fare?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. With Root Cabs, there is no bargaining with drivers. The fare shown in the app is the final ride fare, excluding applicable tolls, parking fees and other charges shown separately.

mainEntity.name: Can I Cancel My Ride After Booking?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can cancel your Root Cabs ride through the app before the trip begins. Cancellation charges may apply based on the booking stage.

mainEntity.name: Can I Book A Ride For Someone Else?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can book a Root Cabs ride for a family member or friend by entering their pickup and drop details along with the correct contact number.

mainEntity.name: What Should I Do If I Need Help With My Booking?

acceptedAnswer.text: Call the Root Cabs support team at +91 86080 66474 for help with pickup details, ride changes, cancellations or other booking-related questions.
